description: This file defines the 'WorkActivityStore' class, which manages activity states related to work sessions, jobs, and tools within an application. It handles updating activity states, managing session roles, and deriving icon states for UI representation.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing active work sessions, tools, icons, and their states, with methods to handle session activities and derive UI states.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A nested struct representing a work activity with session key, role, kind, label, start time, and last update timestamp.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Handles the start or end of a job session based on session key and state.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Handles the start, update, or end of a tool-related activity with phase, name, metadata, and arguments.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Determines and sets the icon state based on a selection or override.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used as a primary reference.
